description: A plain-language engineering cockpit for fcpp-based C/C++ libraries: build, test, dependencies, docs, quality gates, release and board benchmarks — all one click.
config.conanProfiles: Extra Conan -pr profile files appended to every build (maintainer/dev-machine adaptations; not shipped defaults).
config.telemetryEnabled: Opt-in anonymous telemetry (default OFF): counts activations and feature usage locally. No code, no personal data, nothing leaves your machine in this version.
config.envPipIndexUrl: Corporate mirror for the managed lanes: exported as PIP_INDEX_URL (pip: conan/cmake/ninja and the docs stack). Empty = default PyPI.
config.envConanRemote: Mirror of ConanCenter used INSIDE the managed lane (updates the lane's private CONAN_HOME remote; never your ~/.conan2). Empty = conancenter.
config.envHttpProxy: HTTP(S) proxy for the managed lanes (pip/conan/apt): http://proxy.corp:8080. Also honoured by apt inside the WSL/Linux lanes.
config.envWslRootfsUrl: Override the Ubuntu 24.04 WSL rootfs source for the self-provisioned distro (http(s) / file:// / absolute path / UNC share). Intranet mirrors MUST also set wslRootfsSha256 — there is no "skip verification" switch.
config.envWslRootfsSha256: Expected sha256 of the rootfs above. Required whenever wslRootfsUrl is set (a mirror may differ from the official image).
config.envKeepRootfsCache: Keep the downloaded rootfs cache when removing the managed environment (faster re-creation).
cmd.newProject: HeT DevTools: New project from template
cmd.newProjectHere: HeT DevTools: Initialize fcpp project here
cmd.refreshConanIndex: HeT DevTools: Refresh ConanCenter dependency index
